about.title: Who I am & how I work
body: I'm Kevin — Head of Engineering at journaway with more than 10 years of experience in software development. I lead three cross-functional teams with 19 people and, as part of the extended leadership team, shape engineering strategy, organisation and the use of AI across the company.

Before that, I built the frontend team as its team lead. My background as a full-stack developer helps me bring technical quality, product goals and people development together — and I deliberately stay hands-on.

Whether it's a freelance engagement, a full-time role, or a team that needs reinforcement in engineering or leadership: if you're looking for someone who takes ownership and thinks along instead of just executing tickets, let's talk.
